text: Aillén, also written Ellen or Aillene, is a name given to a number of legendary Irish figures. A bearer of the name may be a hero, a heroine, or a spirit. The name is related to Irish words for sprite and for monster. Several of the figures who bear it are so similar that they may be the same being, or descendants of one original. The most famous is Aillén mac Midgna, the burner of Tara. Another is Aillén Trechenn, the triple-headed monster. A third is the brother of the goddess Áine.
objective: Record the name Aillén and its several legendary bearers.
